description: This Java class defines a provider for a signal enrichment service that performs a round-trip trip for each query. It sets up the necessary facades and actor system components to enable the service.

classes.name: ConnectivityByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: A provider class that creates and manages a signal enrichment facade capable of performing round-trip signal enrichment via actor system communication.

methods.name: ConnectivityByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with an actor system and signal enrichment configuration, setting up the actor selection and enrichment facade.

methods.name: getFacade
methods.description: Returns the signal enrichment facade associated with a given connection ID, for use in the connectivity service.

methods.name: getByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentFacade
methods.description: Package-private getter method for retrieving the unique signal enrichment facade instance managed by this provider.
